About Sermorelin

Natural GHRH (growth hormone-releasing hormone) has 44 amino acids, and sermorelin copies the first 29.1 That fragment is the shortest synthetic piece that keeps the hormone's full biological activity, and in human studies it stimulated growth hormone (GH) secretion from the anterior pituitary.13 It binds the GHRH receptor and mimics the natural hormone.2 The GH it raises comes from the body's own pituitary, so sermorelin is a releasing signal, not growth hormone itself.22

The sermorelin for sale here is a 10 mg vial of freeze-dried powder for laboratory research. For the full background, side effects and study doses, read What is Sermorelin?

Research highlights

These human studies are small: the largest treated 110 children.14

  • GH-deficient children: in a multicenter, open-label study, 110 previously untreated prepubertal children were treated for up to a year. In the 86 analyzed for efficacy, mean growth speed rose from 4.1 to 8.0 cm per year at 6 months.14
  • Compared with GH: in a randomized 6-month trial of 60 children with GH deficiency, GH produced faster growth (14.6 cm per year) than GHRH(1-29) given by continuous infusion (9.2 and 9.3 cm per year).15
  • Older men: in 10 healthy older men, 14 days on the higher of two doses raised 24-hour GH and IGF-1 until they no longer differed from those of 9 young men.16
  • Strength and body composition: in a 6-week study of 11 healthy men aged 64 to 76, with no control group, 2 of 6 strength measures and one endurance test improved, while weight and DEXA muscle and fat did not change.17
  • Short action: in 30 healthy men aged 19 to 43, the peptide was cleared quickly after an IV dose, but GH stayed raised for about 3 hours.18
  • Evidence quality: a 2026 review says benefits in healthy people remain uncertain because the human evidence is limited and largely indirect, and it notes that no long-term safety data exist.19

Regulatory status

FDA approved sermorelin acetate as Geref in 1990 as a diagnostic for testing the pituitary's GH release.203 A 1997 approval added a treatment for idiopathic GH deficiency in children with growth failure.83 The maker, EMD Serono, discontinued both products in 2008, and FDA withdrew both approvals effective June 18, 2009.3 In 2013 FDA determined that they were not withdrawn for reasons of safety or effectiveness.3 As of October 2026, Drugs@FDA lists both as discontinued with no label available, and DailyMed holds no sermorelin labels.8209

In a December 10, 2024 warning letter, FDA named an online seller's sermorelin among unapproved new drugs.10 It said labels reading "FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY" and "NOT INTENDED FOR HUMAN USE" did not change that, because the seller's website showed the products were intended for human use.10 Compounded sermorelin is not FDA-approved either.12 WADA's 2026 Prohibited List bans sermorelin at all times, in and out of competition.21

How much should sermorelin cost?

Here the 10 mg vial is listed from $70, and that covers the peptide only. Bacteriostatic water, syringes, needles and alcohol swabs are separate catalog items, each with its own page under Peptide supplies. The strength figure is the amount of peptide in the vial before any diluent is added. This page does not cover compounded prescription products.

Can I just buy sermorelin?

This vial is sold for laboratory research and labeled for research use only. Drugs@FDA lists both Geref products as discontinued and DailyMed holds no sermorelin labels, so no FDA-approved sermorelin appears to be marketed in the US.8209 In a December 2024 warning letter, FDA called one online seller's research-labeled sermorelin an unapproved new drug, because its website showed the products were meant for people.10 Section 503A pharmacy compounding must be based on valid patient-specific prescriptions, and compounded drugs are not FDA-approved.1112

How does the order ship, and what arrives?

Orders ship across the United States. Shipping options and times are kept on the Shipping page rather than repeated here. The vial arrives as a dry powder with no diluent inside, so plan the bacteriostatic water and syringes with the order. Published storage data cover only the approved Geref product, so this page makes no shelf-life claim for this vial.
